title: Artesunate alleviated DSS induced colitis via inhibiting M1 polarization through directly targeting INSR/mTORC1/HIF-1alpha pathway.
authors: Huang, Junjie; Zhou, Ruigang; Peng, Weilong; Wang, Weimei; Chen, Jun; Yu, Chenglong; Wang, Lianggang; Liu, Mingjiang; Bo, Ruonan; Li, Jingui
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究青蒿琥酯通过靶向INSR/mTORC1/HIF-1alpha通路抑制M1巨噬细胞极化缓解结肠炎，属于免疫代谢与疾病机制研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Artesunate (ARS) has demonstrated therapeutic potential in experimental ulcerative colitis (UC) through immunomodulatory activities. However, the role of macrophages and the underlying mechanisms remain unclear. METHODS: In this study, a DSS-induced UC model was established, along with macrophage depletion, polarized macrophage reinfusion, and Transwell coculture systems. The typical colitis characteristics, including weight change, disease activity index, inflammation, and tissue damage, were systematically assessed. Key proteins in the mTORC1/HIF-1alpha pathway were analyzed. SPR-MS was employed to identify ARS targets in M1 macrophages. RESULTS: This study indicated that ARS markedly suppressed DSS-enhanced M1 polarization and macrophage infiltration. In a Caco2-BMDM coculture system, ARS reduced macrophage migration and inflammation. Macrophage depletion significantly attenuated the anti-colitis effect of ARS. Compared with M1 reinfusion, ARS-pretreated M1 cells alleviated UC symptoms. ARS also inhibited LPS- or DSS-induced M1 polarization and proinflammatory cytokine upregulation in vivo and in vitro, linked to mTORC1/HIF-1alpha signaling, as confirmed by the agonist Leucine (LEU). Moreover, ARS protected intestinal barrier function by preventing tight junction loss and permeability increases via suppression of M1 polarization. SPR-MS and molecular docking revealed that ARS directly activated INSR, inhibiting mTORC1/HIF-1alpha-driven glycolytic M1 polarization. CONCLUSIONS: Overall, macrophages are essential for ARS-mediated protection in UC. ARS alleviates UC by reprogramming macrophage polarization via the INSR/mTORC1/HIF-1alpha axis, providing new mechanistic insights and potential clinical applications.
abstract_zh: 引言：青蒿琥酯（Artesunate, ARS）在实验性溃疡性结肠炎（ulcerative colitis, UC）中通过免疫调节活性显示出治疗潜力。然而，巨噬细胞的作用及其潜在机制仍不清楚。方法：本研究建立了DSS诱导的UC模型，以及巨噬细胞耗竭、极化巨噬细胞回输和Transwell共培养系统。系统评估了典型结肠炎特征，包括体重变化、疾病活动指数、炎症和组织损伤。分析了mTORC1/HIF-1alpha通路中的关键蛋白。采用SPR-MS鉴定M1巨噬细胞中ARS的靶点。结果：研究表明，ARS显著抑制DSS增强的M1极化和巨噬细胞浸润。在Caco2-BMDM共培养系统中，ARS减少了巨噬细胞迁移和炎症。巨噬细胞耗竭显著减弱了ARS的抗结肠炎效果。与M1回输相比，ARS预处理的M1细胞缓解了UC症状。ARS还抑制了LPS或DSS诱导的M1极化及促炎细胞因子上调，在体内和体外均与mTORC1/HIF-1alpha信号相关，并通过激动剂亮氨酸（Leucine, LEU）得到证实。此外，ARS通过抑制M1极化，防止紧密连接丢失和通透性增加，从而保护肠道屏障功能。SPR-MS和分子对接揭示，ARS直接激活INSR，抑制mTORC1/HIF-1alpha驱动的糖酵解M1极化。结论：总体而言，巨噬细胞对于ARS介导的UC保护至关重要。ARS通过INSR/mTORC1/HIF-1alpha轴重编程巨噬细胞极化来缓解UC，提供了新的机制见解和潜在临床应用。
